name: rukmani-bakery-pon-cafe
description: Complete Bakery Website & Online Ordering System for PON CAFE / Rukmani Bakery

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
